== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The western [[labyrinth]], also referred to by names such as the [[Dreadgod labyrinth]], the First [[Tomb]], or the forgotten maze, is a massive and nearly impossible-to-navigate structure that spans much of the world. Its primary and most significant hub is situated beneath [[Sacred Valley]]. The facility is characterized by its shifting nature; rather than a fixed physical layout, it functions through complex patterns that make traditional mapping ineffective. While some believe those who master these shifting patterns can reach the center in a single day, many explorers spend years within its depths without ever finding the heart or successfully escaping. The [[labyrinth]] contains various treasures, including relics and security measures left by the ancient [[Soulsmiths]], as well as creations involving [[hunger madra]]. It is protected by legendary defenses that have historically kept the [[Dreadgods]] from locating it, as its entrances typically remain sealed. However, the opening of an outer hatch can draw their attention. There is also evidence that [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] utilizes spatial transportation and may have been designed to keep a lone inhabitant in a state of starvation. The structure is linked to the seven founders, one of whom possessed a power similar to pure, universal restoration.}}
